description: Create a winter wonderland with the fun blinkin’ Santa. The eyes blink, move and wink! A quirky and fun Christmas decoration. Auto timer, 6 hours on/18 hours off. Requires 3 x AA batteries (not included). Polyresin. Comes boxed. H25 x W18cm. Suitable for indoor or outdoor use. AA batteries are available in packs of 10 on code 13458 for only £3 / €3.60.
